slot.brief: Two-stage motion or average speed with equal distances at two speeds; set up simultaneous equations

stem: A vehicle covers two equal distances. Its speed over the first distance is $30$ km h$^{-1}$ and its average speed over the whole journey is $24$ km h$^{-1}$. Find its speed over the second distance.

verdicts.working: For equal distances, the average speed is the harmonic mean: 24 = 2/(1/30 + 1/v). Solving gives v = 20 km h⁻¹.

working:
$\dfrac{d}{30}+\dfrac{d}{v}=\dfrac{2d}{24}$
$\dfrac{1}{30}+\dfrac{1}{v}=\dfrac{1}{12}$
$\dfrac{1}{v}=\dfrac{1}{20}$
$v=20$ km h$^{-1}$

Independent check: For equal distances, the average speed is the harmonic mean: 24 = 2/(1/30 + 1/v). Solving gives v = 20 km h⁻¹.
